name: send_notification
description: Send a notification to a person or team via the configured channel (SES email, ServiceNow incident, or Jira issue). Use for inquiry emails, approval requests, confirmations, and escalations. The recipient format depends on the channel: email address (SES), assignment group (ServiceNow), or project key (Jira).

recipient.description: Who to notify — email address, ServiceNow group, or Jira project key
